subject: Priv deploy: authZ + SAML/SCIM federation — staging cutover checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Acme Security <security@acme.com>; Acme Infra <infra@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Priv deploy: authZ + SAML/SCIM federation — staging cutover checklist

Hi team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our runbook we want to lock the staging cutover window for the private control plane and confirm a few identity items so the on-prem staging rollout is smooth:

1) SAML SSO: Acme will provide the IdP metadata (including cert with thumbprint) and the Assertion Consumer URL we should use for the staging tenancy. Confirm: staging uses the same SP endpoints as prod but different tenant ID, correct?
2) SCIM provisioning: we need the expected attribute set for group -> role mapping (e.g., acme:department -> redwood_role). The attached CSV is our recommended minimal mapping for the initial rollout.
3) Operator roles & service accounts: who will be the first three operator identities (email addresses) that get the "priv-admin" role for staging? We will pre-create service-account bindings and provide Terraform snippets.
4) Cert rotation: we plan a short blackout (5 min) for SAML cert swap during the cutover. Need Acme's ok.

Action: please confirm items 1–4 by EOD Tuesday PT. I'll prepare the cutover playbook and runbook docs in the shared Drive.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Product Ops — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: priv-deploy-staging-checklist.xlsx, saml-metadata-acme.xml
From: Acme Security <security@acme.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Infra <infra@acme.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: authZ + SAML/SCIM federation — staging cutover checklist

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers:

1) SAML metadata attached (saml-metadata-acme.xml). Staging tenant has unique ID but uses same SP endpoints — correct. We expect you to accept the tenant override parameter during handshake.
2) SCIM: we can provide department, title, and custom:entitlements attributes. We'll push a delta to the provisioning endpoint — SCIM PATCH only, no full push.
3) Operator identities: infra@acme.com, sec-ops@acme.com, and alice.leung@acme.com for initial bindings.
4) Cert rotation: 5-min blackout looks fine — prefer the swap at 02:00 UTC to minimize user impact.

Also one ask: we require an audit trail of SCIM deltas (who/when) retained for 365 days, and exported to our S3 bucket daily for compliance. Is that supported in the private control plane?

Regards,
Marcus O. (on behalf of Acme Security)

Attachment: saml-metadata-acme.xml
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Acme Security <security@acme.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: authZ + SAML/SCIM federation — staging cutover checklist

Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the metadata. A few technical notes from our side:

- Tenant override: confirmed, the SP will accept a tenant_id override parameter during initial AuthN request; we'll add explicit guidance to the runbook.
- SCIM delta retention: the private control plane supports event logging for provisioning events. We can configure a daily export to your S3 endpoint (signed URL) and keep a 365-day retention. We'll need the S3 bucket ARN and a presigned write role or temporary creds for the export agent.
- SCIM PATCH semantics: our SCIM adapter supports incremental PATCH and will emit a change event for each PATCH request with a change-id. We will include change-id and actor email in the audit record.

Ben — can you validate the sample mapping in scim-provisioning-matrix.csv attached? Specific ask: map acme:entitlements values ["redwood:priv-admin","redwood:observer"] to our internal roles.

I'll schedule the cert rotation for 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC per Marcus, with a 10-min pre-notice slack ping.

Laura Bennett
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-provisioning-matrix.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: authZ + SAML/SCIM federation — staging cutover checklist

Quick validation from infra:

- Mapping looks good. We'll map redwood:priv-admin -> role_id:priv_admin and redwood:observer -> role_id:observer in the initial Terraform templates.
- For SCIM PATCH edge-cases: we recommend Acme include an "externalId" on user resources to make reconciliation idempotent; otherwise we'll attempt match by email. Note in our experience some customers send email updates that cause dupes unless externalId is present.
- Service account provisioning: we'll hand over a Terraform snippet that creates the provider credentials and attaches the appropriate role bindings (see Drive link).

I'll attach the snippets to the runbook before the cutover.

Ben Carter
Platform Engineer — Private Deploy
Redwood Inference
From: Acme Infra <infra@acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Acme Security <security@acme.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T17:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priv deploy: authZ + SAML/SCIM federation — staging cutover checklist

Laura/Ben —

All good on our side. Confirming the following for the cutover on 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC (planned maintenance window):

- Bucket ARN for audit export: arn:aws:s3:::acme-privcp-exports (we will create a write policy and send role ARN).
- We'll include externalId on SCIM payloads going forward; temporary window for older identities exists but we will backfill where needed.
- Operator emails confirmed (infra@acme.com, sec-ops@acme.com, alice.leung@acme.com).

Two small requests:
1) Can Redwood provide a short rollback plan if SAML cert rotation fails? Ideally a step-by-step to revert to previous cert without tenant downtime.
2) Will there be a canary period (10 users) before we flip provisioning for the whole staging tenant? We prefer a small canary to validate role assignments.

If both are possible we are green to proceed.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez (Acme Infra)
On Tue, May 4, 2026 at 08:40 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Diego/Team —
>
> Good questions. We'll include a rollback path in the runbook: keep previous cert staged, query authn endpoints to confirm response codes, and if failures occur revert the SP metadata and re-publish. I will add exact CLI snippets and who to call (oncall list).
>
> We'll also run a 10-user canary 30 minutes after the swap. If all good, we proceed to full provisioning.
>
> I'll update Drive with the final playbook and push the DocuSign link for acceptance later today.
>
> —Laura
